# 21. directional-score-diagnostics

**目的**：directional modelの構成ラスタと最終スコアを数値診断する。

```{r c21_directional_score_diagnostics, eval=TRUE}
score_layers <- list(
  source_seed_strength = source_seed_strength_r,
  open_source_strength = open_source_strength_r,
  no_data_contact = no_data_contact_r,
  supported_density_score = supported_density_score_r,
  isolated_dwelling_signal = isolated_dwelling_signal_r,

  macro_internal_context = macro_internal_context_r,
  internal_macro_absence = internal_macro_absence_r,
  external_absence_barrier = external_absence_barrier_r,
  external_absence_evidence = external_absence_evidence_r,
  external_absence_continuity_score = external_absence_continuity_score_r,
  absence_barrier_shadow = absence_barrier_shadow_r,
  absence_barrier_strength = absence_barrier_strength_r,

  artificial_modified_binary = artificial_modified_binary_r,
  artificial_modified_ratio = artificial_modified_ratio_r,
  modified_unavailable_no_data = modified_unavailable_no_data_r,
  prediction_target_binary = prediction_target_binary_r,

  directional_allowed = directional_allowed_r,
  directional_normalized_cost = directional_normalized_cost_r,
  directional_source_strength = directional_source_strength_r,
  directional_source_range_m = directional_source_range_m_r,
  cluster_continuity_score_all_cells = cluster_continuity_score_all_cells_r,
  cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only = cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only_r
)

summarise_raster_values <- function(r, layer_name) {
  vals <- terra::values(r, mat = FALSE)
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]

  if (length(vals) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      layer = layer_name,
      n = 0,
      n_positive = 0,
      min = NA_real_,
      q25 = NA_real_,
      median = NA_real_,
      q75 = NA_real_,
      q95 = NA_real_,
      max = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    layer = layer_name,
    n = length(vals),
    n_positive = sum(vals > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(vals, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
    median = stats::median(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(vals, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
    q95 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(vals, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max = max(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

final_directional_score_diagnostics <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  score_layers,
  summarise_raster_values
)

print(final_directional_score_diagnostics)

readr::write_csv(
  final_directional_score_diagnostics,
  file.path(final_csv_dir, "final_directional_score_diagnostics.csv")
)

final_directional_parameters <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  analysis_parameter_table |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      group,
      parameter,
      value = as.character(value),
      meaning
    ),
  tibble::tibble(
    group = "runtime",
    parameter = "selected_d_adj_safe_m",
    value = as.character(selected_d_adj_safe_m),
    meaning = "DBSCAN候補から求めた代表的隣接距離"
  ),
  tibble::tibble(
    group = "runtime",
    parameter = "base_range_m",
    value = as.character(base_range_m),
    meaning = "selected_d_adj_safe_mとbase_range_min_mから計算した基本到達距離"
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  final_directional_parameters,
  file.path(final_csv_dir, "final_directional_parameters.csv")
)
```

# 23. export-final-gpkg

**目的**：interimとfinal成果をGeoPackageにまとめる。

```{r c23_export_final_gpkg, eval=TRUE}
if (file.exists(final_gpkg)) {
  unlink(final_gpkg)
}

# interimレイヤも同じGPKGに再出力する。
write_gpkg_layer_safe(dwelling_points_grouped_macro, final_gpkg, "interim_dwelling_points_grouped")
write_gpkg_layer_safe(group_geometries_interim, final_gpkg, "interim_group_geometries")
write_gpkg_layer_safe(macro_group_geometries_interim, final_gpkg, "interim_macro_cluster_geometries")
write_gpkg_layer_safe(macro_cluster_link_edges, final_gpkg, "interim_macro_cluster_link_edges")
write_gpkg_layer_safe(internal_void_candidates, final_gpkg, "interim_internal_void_candidates")
write_gpkg_layer_safe(
  grid10_status |>
    dplyr::select(
      grid_id,
      response,
      cell_status,
      dwelling_count,
      surveyed_ratio,
      surveyed_area_m2,
      cell_area_m2
    ),
  final_gpkg,
  "interim_grid_status"
)

# finalレイヤ。
write_gpkg_layer_safe(dwelling_points_final, final_gpkg, "final_dwelling_points_with_support")
write_gpkg_layer_safe(macro_group_geometries_final, final_gpkg, "final_macro_cluster_isolation_support")

final_grid_extract_points <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_point_on_surface(grid10))

extract_one_final_raster <- function(r, value_name) {
  r_tmp <- r
  names(r_tmp) <- value_name
  values_tmp <- terra::extract(
    r_tmp,
    terra::vect(final_grid_extract_points),
    ID = FALSE
  ) |>
    tibble::as_tibble()

  values_tmp <- values_tmp[, 1, drop = FALSE]
  names(values_tmp) <- value_name
  values_tmp
}

final_grid_values <- dplyr::bind_cols(
  extract_one_final_raster(
    cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only_r,
    "cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only"
  ),
  extract_one_final_raster(
    cluster_continuity_score_all_cells_r,
    "cluster_continuity_score_all_cells"
  ),
  extract_one_final_raster(
    directional_normalized_cost_r,
    "directional_normalized_cost"
  ),
  extract_one_final_raster(
    directional_source_strength_r,
    "directional_source_strength"
  ),
  extract_one_final_raster(
    absence_barrier_strength_r,
    "absence_barrier_strength"
  ),
  extract_one_final_raster(
    artificial_modified_binary_r,
    "artificial_modified_binary"
  ),
  extract_one_final_raster(
    artificial_modified_ratio_r,
    "artificial_modified_ratio"
  ),
  extract_one_final_raster(
    modified_unavailable_no_data_r,
    "modified_unavailable_no_data"
  ),
  extract_one_final_raster(
    prediction_target_binary_r,
    "prediction_target_binary"
  ),
  extract_one_final_raster(
    isolated_dwelling_signal_r,
    "isolated_dwelling_signal"
  )
)

final_score_grid <- dplyr::bind_cols(
  grid10 |>
    dplyr::select(
      grid_id,
      response,
      cell_status,
      dwelling_count,
      surveyed_ratio
    ),
  final_grid_values
)

final_score_grid_no_data <- final_score_grid |>
  dplyr::filter(
    cell_status == "no_data",
    !is.na(cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only)
  )

write_gpkg_layer_safe(
  final_score_grid_no_data,
  final_gpkg,
  "final_directional_continuity_grid_no_data"
)

if (nrow(final_score_grid_no_data) > 0) {
  high_score_threshold <- stats::quantile(
    final_score_grid_no_data$cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only,
    0.95,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  final_score_grid_no_data_high <- final_score_grid_no_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      cluster_continuity_score_no_data_only >= high_score_threshold
    )

  write_gpkg_layer_safe(
    final_score_grid_no_data_high,
    final_gpkg,
    "final_directional_continuity_grid_no_data_top5pct"
  )
}

cat("final gpkg:", final_gpkg, "\n")
```
